g.text: A hand runs saturated: most of it is pinned at the torque ceiling

g.text: Joints at their torque limit, of 16, averaged over the episode — the weaker the actuator, the more of the hand

g.text: The real Allegro peaks at 0.70 N·m per joint and is documented as torque-saturation-limited in tool use; this is that limit, counted.
